notes.title: Early Access Content Update!
notes.content:
Hi y'all!

We're very happy that you like our game, and as you may have noticed, we've updated our Early Access version.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323907/dff47809616854a24a73d34640b31558ed8f5e44.jpg

Here's what we did:

Added Features:

Full controller support: you can now use your game pad/controller for every aspect of the game. Possible interactions are supported with the corresponding displayed buttons.
ACHIEVEMENTS! We've added a whopping 25 Steam achievements to the game. Disclaimer: two achievements cannot be unlocked yet as they're intended for planned features yet to come.
Achievement menu: we've added a separate achievement menu where you can view your achievements.
Greenhouses: we've now added greenhouses to the game allowing you to grow crops. In order to do so, you'll need the plant and water. You can add water using a water tank or a water drone.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323907/974cde72f28f78381b9951c24413bf78ef193f61.png
Water drones: Water drones put water into greenhouses. Contrary to standard drones you'll only have to set their destination. The drone will then automatically head for the nearest water pump in order to procure water. You'll need at least one pump station in order for the water drone to work.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323907/36db11fc81a78be5871b9b556560b88321ecf231.png
Pump station: the pump station is the water drone's source for water.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323907/59462f41145d164c7e35703b20e295c987b2efb6.png


Improvements & Bug Fixes

Fixed a miscalculation concering wheat's research points
Butter factory now produces butter instead of french fries
Fixed a display error in the cheese bread factory.
Adjusted the tractor's speed in order to prevent its deceleration
Added a missing display of a button allocation in the settings menu

Knows Issues

It happens that factories and buildings bought from the shop may land on already placed buildings in case they're built in the shop's proximity

Stay tuned for more upcoming updates!
